title: BenchSaaS — Enterprise Application LLM Benchmark Report V1.0
byline: By Nocoly & Mingdao AI Tech Group
excerpt: BenchSaaS is an enterprise application LLM benchmark by Nocoly & Mingdao AI Tech Group, evaluating 10 models across 30 configurations and 9,000 runs on 100 real-world CRM, inventory, and finance tasks.
content_html:
Evaluating LLM Delivery
in Real Enterprise Workflows

Built by Nocoly & Mingdao AI Tech Group on the isomorphic HAP (Hyper Application Platform) testbed, BenchSaaS tests whether models understand business goals, retrieve accurate facts, obey operational constraints, and deliver usable enterprise records across CRM, inventory, and finance.

Eval Window: Oct 22 – Nov 19, 2026 (CST) Testbed: 40 HAP Tables / 18,014 Business Records Verification: Programmatic Checks + Independent Judge
